description: Complete covering set analysis for Erdős-Straus conjecture n≡1(mod 12)

local_solvability_proof.p_ge_5: Always solvable by Hensel lift from nonsingular mod p solution
local_solvability_proof.p_3: Always solvable; mod 9/27 verified by brute force
local_solvability_proof.p_2: Always solvable; mod 8/16 verified by brute force

hasse_minkowski.form: k² + 36(A²-9)t² - 36m² - B² = 0 is a quadric in 3 variables (k,t,m)
hasse_minkowski.conclusion: Rational solution exists for any odd A≠3 and any n≡1(mod 12)

covering_set.key_insight: A=3 is degenerate (A²-9=0 → binary form). For A≠3, Hasse-Minkowski guarantees rational solutions.

numerical_verification.note: Integer solutions verified for A=3 failing cases with A=7,23,31
